operations.decision: Immutable process-wide snapshots hold real/effective/saved IDs, bounded supplementary groups, no-new-privileges and a monotonically decreasing fixed authority ceiling. Credential decisions retain one snapshot; denied mutation preserves state. Fork/clone inherit snapshots, and the canonical process owner survives main-thread retirement. Workers from a replaced address space cannot mutate replacement credentials. Goal19 9DB requires all live credential-owner contributors in safe waits before effective-ID-changing exec commits. Epoch release and marker withdrawal share the resource lock, including rejected worker handoffs, so a later exec cannot reuse a leaving wait. Final publication revalidates the admitted snapshot; bounded failure releases temporary admission without changing image, credentials or CLOEXEC. 9DZ qualifies this credential foundation against requirement1 and the credential-publication portion of requirement2: current host publication tests, native saved-ID/group/no-regain tests, exec concurrency, retired-owner lifetime, multithreaded set-ID/nosuid and isolated kernel admission/accounting tests pass. Complete exec-image/version/fence behavior and authenticated remote identity mapping remain tracked by the separate exec and WKI rows; this status does not close those requirements.

Link control reserves namespace/native-MAC admission before fallible driver work, serializes writers per device, publishes fields only on success, and exposes coherent snapshots with retirement winning. IPv4 configuration and IPv6 address/connected-route updates preserve owned observations and transactional refusals. Queue moves admit the complete batch before changing placement or MSI-X routing. Mapped OPEN/CLOSE/LINK require negotiated complete credentials, exact retained channel/binding and captured peer policy; REMOTE_NET and shared-ID trust precede central NETWORK_ADMIN, with root-inclusive trust required for active service grants. Unsupported credentialless controls refuse ENOTSUP. 9OA captured transient connected-peer lifecycle exclusion before OPEN send. 9OB retains the same request or completed reply through at most100ms of pre-publication retries, stops on WKI_OK or retirement/deadline, and never repeats driver effects or remaps identity. Owner errno and transport errno remain separate; denied authority leaves state unchanged. Current full KTEST60035/0 and150 live NIC checks qualify the change; unchanged address/hostname/queue paths reuse9NZ live evidence explicitly. General post-send unknown outcomes are not promised away. The requirement-level network/hostname audit is complete; broader WKI identity/resource audits remain pending. See docs/security/audits/net_control_retry.md.

operations.decision: Configured peer identity defaults to deny independently of operation permission. Canonical complete snapshots preserve all six IDs, supplementary groups, restrictions, ceilings and sealed grants; nonroot trust rejects any root ID/group and active service authority. Compute, VFS read/open/mutation and network control map through operation-specific captured authenticated policy before explicit native authorization. Deferred work owns request bytes, policy/capabilities and exact session/binding identities; it never borrows worker-root authority. Original and resulting exec credentials are both admitted, construction remains private and final compute publication revalidates sealed session/channel ownership. Legacy identity is usable only when complete Snapshot round-trip is exact; unsupported selectors/versions refuse without ambient fallback. Retained directory transfer binds complete identity, source/recipient/submission and exact scope, while declared LOCAL VFS routing remains intact. Ordinary signals map current caller authority; relationship control events retain narrower grants. 9OC reconciles current consumer implementations with the completed exec/VFS/signal/network qualifications and fresh four-node identity/service checks. Existing-resource grants and their lifetime remain a separate pending wki-resources domain. The preserved four-node stale-root EINVAL/EBUSY observation is an unresolved resource-publication failure, not a passing filesystem readiness check or an observed credential mapping bypass. See docs/security/audits/wki_identity_audit.md.

operations.decision: Current Goal19 resource authorization is reconciled in docs/security/audits/resource_enforcement.md (9OE). New authority maps an explicit canonical caller Snapshot under RX-admitted peer operation/identity policy before confined native work. Existing VFS descriptions require exact channel allocation/generation, admitted data mode and retained readonly policy; metadata mutation separately checks the current mapped caller. Per-channel workers serialize ordinary descriptor operations; binding references drain before detach, export or stale-peer cleanup releases Files. IPC grants match immutable issued consumer/resource/type and retain Files; import home identity binds to the authenticated submitter, publication binds original RESOURCE/DATA allocations plus cleanup epoch, and unanswered control cookies survive uncertain completion. Legacy operations lacking target authority refuse. Process access to remote devices and mounts goes through central DEVFS/MOUNT admission and exact source observation. Block attachment requires every requested permission; immutable binding read/write restrictions precede scalar/ring callbacks. Zone/device users retain exact backing, peer, direction and original channel authority across deferred work and retirement. No worker-root substitution or numeric-path replacement supplies new process authority. The prior accumulated pending narrative is preserved in build/goal19-resource-enforcement/before/; current VFS, signal, network and identity domain audits supersede its stale missing-consumer assertions. The9OC stale-root EINVAL/EBUSY availability failure remains unfixed; owner backing admission/retirement is independently qualified. Raw RDMA authentication, replay/rkey revocation and universal wire-ID nonreuse are not certified here and remain Goal25 transport scope. See the current checklist for precise evidence and limits; full nine-requirement goal completion is a separate audit.
